facts.text: Evan had a pee accident near some roses, which he found embarrassing the next morning.

evidence.quote: Oof, Sam, so embarrassing! I had a pee accident near some roses - can you believe it?
I was so embarrassed when I saw what happened the next morning, so I apologized and luckily they were understanding.

facts.text: Evan apologized for the incident and was met with understanding from the people involved.

evidence.quote: I apologized and luckily they were understanding.
Yeah, they were understanding, which was great.

facts.text: Evan mentioned that the incident was a reminder to be more careful in the future.

evidence.quote: I was out of control--guess I gotta be more careful next time.
But it's a good reminder to be more careful.

facts.text: Evan and his partner tried snowshoeing this weekend as a new adventure.

evidence.quote: my partner and I tried snowshoeing this weekend. It was part of a new adventure for us and surprisingly fun.
